repos_data.description: Open-source speech recognition toolkit for training, inference, streaming ASR, VAD, punctuation, speaker diarization pipelines, and OpenAI-compatible/MCP serving.
A scalable generative AI framework built for researchers and developers working on Large Language Models, Multimodal, and Speech AI (Automatic Speech Recognition and Text-to-Speech)
Offline speech recognition API for Android, iOS, Raspberry Pi and servers with Python, Java, C# and Node
🎙️ AI Dictation App - Open Source and Local-first ⚡ Type 3x faster, no keyboard needed. 🆓 Powered by open source models, works offline, fast and accurate.
Natural voice conversations with Claude Code
Espresso: A Fast End-to-End Neural Speech Recognition Toolkit
We've moved to SGLang Omni Voxt: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-omni/tree/main/Voxt
Transcribe any video URL or audio file into plaintext. No GPU. No cloud. One command.

A speech-to-text system you can train for $25. A frozen speech encoder and a Qwen LLM joined by a small trained projector, with word timestamps, speaker diarization, a batched HTTP server, a live demo, and a free course.

Push-to-talk voice typing for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android. On-device or cloud speech recognition, AI polish with presets, a dictionary, rules and scenes, long recordings with subtitles; the phone works on its own or pairs end-to-end encrypted as the computer's microphone and keyboard.
Streaming on-device speech recognition for Android — NEON-accelerated FastConformer (32M params), cache-aware streaming with 80 ms look-ahead, no cloud. Powered by the VoxRT runtime.

Token-lean web microfetch for LLM agents: any URL → clean markdown via CLI, MCP server, and Claude Code plugin. Real browser-cookie auth, passkeys, anti-bot reach, on-by-default prompt-injection defense, plus on-device multimodal ASR/OCR. A single Rust binary — not a browser.
Tiny android dictation app that turns speech into clear writing.

On-device streaming ASR (speech-to-text) for Linux x86_64 + aarch64 — one hardened .so behind Python (PyPI), Node.js (npm), Go (go get), C/C++ (tarball + CMake). AVX2 on servers, NEON on edge. RNN-T + CTC, RTF 0.06–0.08 on x86_64. Same runtime as voxrt-asr-{android,ios}.
